title: hint-1
text: Look carefully at each option and ask yourself: is this a built-in Python data type or something else?

title: hint-2
text: Some options may look similar, but only the exact Python type names count as built-in data types.

title: hint-3
text: In Python, built-in data types include numeric types, text types, and boolean types. Exclude anything that is just a word, not an actual type name.
